owner_cash.method_note: Mechanical OCF-capex is diagnostic only. Central owner cash retains SBC as a real compensation cost and uses a modest normalization reserve for working-capital, tax and acquisition timing.

growth_quality.note: Rough ex-Informatica growth subtracts disclosed Informatica revenue but does not adjust FX, cross-sell or acquisition integration effects; it is a diagnostic, not a company-reported organic metric.

per_share.asr_note: Large share reduction is primarily driven by the debt-funded $25B accelerated share repurchase; do not treat the full EPS lift as operating improvement.
